China coverage includes Taiwan Affairs Office responses, He Lifeng's video address, and Fujian's acting governor appointment; finance examines AI's bond-market role, Hong Kong growth, and an ECB hike signal. sections.briefing_title_en: Science and Technology: Asteroid Missions, Deep-Space Milestones and Medical Advances
sections.briefing_summary_en: This issue reports that Hera has captured the first clear view of the asteroid pair involved in NASA's impact experiment, Voyager 1 is nearing one light-day from Earth, Ryugu samples contain all five DNA and RNA nucleobases, and Betelgeuse may host a hidden companion passing through its atmosphere. In medicine and physics, gene editing as a replacement for lifetime medication faces long-term safety questions, cancer cells are induced to make drugs that kill them, an Alzheimer's drug shows potential to repair DNA damage and reduce inflammation, and the LHC finds evidence that smaller collisions can create quark-gluon plasma.
